title: Cancellation Settlements Paid to the Card on Hotel Rate Plans Reservations
content:
Where a guest asks for the money back on a cancelled Hotel Rate Plans reservation, a cancellation settlement returns it to the card the reservation was originally paid with. This note states what such a settlement is and how it is recorded.

## What governs the settlement

**The amount returned to the card is settled only after the folio carries the cancellation penalty withheld on every room given up.** Until a cancellation penalty covering every room given up stands on that reservation's folio, the amount returned to the card is not settled.

A cancellation settlement is raised as one payout against the earliest prepayment line still standing on the reservation, meaning the prepayment line carrying the lowest room sequence that no payout already stands against, and it covers every element of the settlement together. Because the settlement is raised as one payout covering every element together, the ceiling on it is the ceiling that governs the settlement rather than what the prepayment line it is raised against collected on its own, and the reservation's payouts may together reach that ceiling.

## The capability that records it

`raise_cancellation_refund_payout_a740a404` returns money to the card a guest originally paid a hotel reservation with. One call posts a single payout line to the reservation's folio against the earlier money-in line named, carrying the stated amount as money leaving the folio, so the guest sees the payout on the folio and the sum reaching the card they paid with; the folio's other lines are left exactly as they stand.

## How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then called by the desk. It is not a tool the guest runs.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the hotel reservation being settled | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `source_entry_id` | the reference number of the earlier folio line this payout is raised against | an identifier, read from the folio lines returned by the folio lookup before this call |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the money returned to the guest's card | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means nothing reaches the card |

None of the three parameters carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the payout line just created on the folio, the reference of the earlier folio line it was raised against, and the amount returned as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the payout was posted; an absent line or an error text means nothing was returned.
